DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ATMのお取引について、ご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about an ATM transaction?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 紙幣と硬貨を預けたいです。この機械に硬貨を入れる所が見つからないのですが、紙幣の所へ一緒に入れるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 硬貨を紙幣投入口へ混ぜて入れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to deposit banknotes and coins. I cannot find a coin slot on this machine. Should I put them together in the banknote slot?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to mix coins into the banknote slot. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紙幣の所へ硬貨を入れないでください。こちらの機械は、今は紙幣のお預けだけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not put coins in the banknote slot. This machine currently accepts banknote deposits only.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ何も入れていません。百円玉を紙幣の間に挟んでいたので、先に分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未投入で紙幣間の百円玉を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not put anything in yet. I had a 100-yen coin between the notes, so I will separate it first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say nothing has been inserted and separate the 100-yen coin from between the notes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 硬貨のお預けは、窓口で取扱いを確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check at the counter how coin deposits are handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 紙幣は五千円札一枚です。今日は機械へ入れる物をそれだけにして、硬貨は別に持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 五千札一枚だけ機械へ預け硬貨は別保管する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have one 5,000-yen note. Today I will put only that in the machine and keep the coins separate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Deposit only one 5,000-yen note in the machine and keep the coins separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 紙幣も、クリップなどを外してご用意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please remove clips and similar items from the banknotes too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: クリップを外しました。硬貨が残っていないか確かめてから、紙幣一枚を入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: クリップと残硬貨を除いて紙幣一枚を入れる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have removed the clip. After checking that no coins remain, I will insert the single note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Remove the clip and any remaining coins, then insert one note. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 画面の金額をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the amount on the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 画面は五千円になっています。今日ここで預ける紙幣一枚の金額と合っていますね。硬貨の手続きは窓口で聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 画面五千円を投入紙幣と照合し硬貨預入は別途窓口へ相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: The screen shows 5,000 yen. It matches the single banknote I am depositing here today. I will ask about the coin procedure at the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare the screen's 5,000 yen with the note inserted and consult the counter separately about depositing coins. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、画面の案内に沿ってお進みください。ご確認ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please continue following the screen instructions. Thank you for checking. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 袋詰めで、何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Can I help you with packing your bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 持ってきた袋へ牛乳を入れたら、底が折れたままで傾きました。全部持ち上げずに、いったん置いて直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 袋底が折れて牛乳傾斜し置いて直したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I put milk in the bag I brought, it tilted because the bottom was still folded. I want to set it down and fix it rather than lift everything up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the folded bag bottom caused the milk to tilt and ask to set it down to fix it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの台をご利用ください。牛乳は、先に取り出しておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please use this counter. Let us take the milk out first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 取り出しました。袋の底の角を広げると、平らになります。穴が開いたのではありませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 牛乳を除き角を広げ穴なしと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have taken it out. Opening the corners at the bottom makes it flat. It was not a hole after all.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Remove the milk, spread the corners and confirm there is no hole. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 平らになった所へ、重い物から入れられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Now that it is flat, you can put in the heavy items first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 牛乳を底へ置きます。パンは牛乳の下へ押し込まず、最後に上へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 重牛乳を底にパンを後上部へ入れる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will put the milk at the bottom. I will not push the bread under the milk; I will put it on top last.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Put the heavy milk at the bottom and the bread on top afterward. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 持ち手も二つそろえてお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please hold both handles together as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 両方の持ち手をそろえました。少し持ち上げて、牛乳が傾かないか見てから帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 両持ち手をそろえ持上げ時に牛乳が傾かないか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have brought both handles together. I will lift it a little and check whether the milk tilts before going home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Bring both handles together and check whether the milk tilts when lifting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お忘れの商品はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you forgotten any of your purchases?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 牛乳とパンの二つ、入っています。台に何も残っていません。袋をゆっくり持ち上げて帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二商品と台の残りなしを確かめ持ち上げる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Both items, the milk and bread, are inside. Nothing is left on the counter. I will slowly lift the bag and head home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check that both purchases are inside and nothing remains on the counter, then lift the bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 袋の底を広げられてよかったです。それでは、お荷物を安定させてお持ち帰りください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I am glad you could open out the bag's bottom. Please keep your purchases stable as you carry them home. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらは、これから草刈り作業に入ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: We are about to begin grass cutting here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いつもの散歩道なので来ました。端だけ空いていれば、今のうちに通ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 草刈り前なら狭い端を通れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came because this is my usual walking path. If just the edge is clear, may I pass through now before you start?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may pass along the narrow edge before grass cutting starts. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの区間へは入らず、別の道をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not enter this section; use another path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。作業の区間を避けて歩きたいので、別の道を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 作業区間を避けるため別の道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I would like to avoid the work section, so please show me another path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for another path to avoid the work section. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 池の反対側の通路から回れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can go around via the path on the opposite side of the pond.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 池の反対側の通路ですね。そちらを通ると、出口まで戻れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 池の反対側通路から出口へ戻れるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: The path on the opposite side of the pond, correct? Can I get back to the exit using it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether the path on the opposite side of the pond leads back to the exit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、出口へつながっています。作業区間は、この黄色い表示で示しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, it connects to the exit. The work section is indicated by these yellow signs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この黄色い表示の内側なのですね。帰りも同じ道を使う予定だったので、戻る時も区間を避けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 黄色作業表示と帰路でも回避を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: So it is inside these yellow signs. I had planned to use the same path on the way back, so I will avoid this section when returning too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the yellow work signs and that you will also avoid the section on your return. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 再び通れる時刻は、この場では決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We cannot determine here what time it will be passable again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は反対側の通路から帰ります。次に来る時も、作業の表示を見てから道を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 時刻で再開と断定せず本日は反対側帰宅を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I will go home by the path on the opposite side. Next time I come, I will check the work signs before choosing a path too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Without assuming a reopening time, decide to return by the opposite-side path today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 迂回にご協力いただきありがとうございます。それでは、池の反対側から散歩をお楽しみください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for taking the detour. Please enjoy your walk on the opposite side of the pond. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ホームでお困りのことがあるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are having a problem on the platform, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 携帯を線路へ落としました。見えていますが、拾いに降りずに駅員さんへ知らせに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 線路の携帯を自己回収せず駅員へ報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I dropped my phone onto the tracks. I can see it, but I came to tell station staff instead of going down to retrieve it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the phone on the tracks to station staff without retrieving it yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 近づかないでください。どのホームの、どの辺りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please stay away from it. Which platform, and whereabouts?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このホームの三番の乗車位置付近です。ホームから下をのぞき続けず、案内板の前で待っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ホームの乗車位置と自分の待機位置を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Near boarding position 3 on this platform. I am waiting in front of the information board rather than continuing to peer down from the platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the platform boarding position and where you are waiting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 職員が確認します。携帯の特徴は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: A staff member will check. Can you describe the phone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 黒いケースで、裏に白いシールがあります。自分の携帯ですが、今、取り戻せるかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 黒ケースと白シールの特徴を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It has a black case with a white sticker on the back. It is my phone, but I do not know whether it can be retrieved now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the black case and white sticker. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 回収の時期や扱いは、担当の確認を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please wait for the responsible staff member's confirmation about when and how it will be recovered.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。棒を使って引き寄せたり、友人に降りてもらったりしません。確認が終わるまで乗車を待ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 道具や友人で回収せず乗車を待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will not pull it closer with a stick or have a friend go down. I would like to wait to board until the check is complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not retrieve it with tools or a friend and will wait to board. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お待ちになる場所を担当からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The responsible staff member will tell you where to wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。友人とはこの駅で会う予定なので、携帯が使えないことを伝える方法も相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人との合流に携帯を使えないため連絡方法も相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I am supposed to meet a friend at this station, so I would also like advice on how to tell them I cannot use my phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Since you cannot use your phone to meet your friend, consult them about a way to make contact as well. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、そちらでお待ちください。担当へ知らせます。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait over there. I will notify the responsible staff member. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 防災の相談窓口をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the disaster preparedness consultation desk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 猫を二匹飼っています。避難が必要になった時に備えて、準備を相談したいです。今日は災害は起きていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 平常時に猫二匹との避難準備を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have two cats. I would like advice on preparations in case we need to evacuate. There is no disaster happening today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Consult them during normal times about evacuation preparations with two cats. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 平常時のご相談ですね。動物を連れる場合の案内を担当へ確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is a consultation during normal times, then. We can ask the person in charge for information about bringing animals.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。人と同じ部屋に入れると思い込まず、どこで待つのかも先に知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 人と同室と思わず待機場所の条件を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. I do not want to assume they can stay in the same room as people, and would like to know beforehand where they would wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Without assuming people and pets can share a room, ask about the conditions for where they will wait. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 場所や受入条件は、担当の案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the responsible staff member's guidance about locations and acceptance conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 猫を運ぶ物もまだ一つしかありません。今の家で用意できる物を、一覧で聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 猫二匹に運搬容器一つの不足を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I also only have one carrier so far. I would like a list of things I can prepare at home now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report that you have two cats but only one carrier, which is insufficient. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内の内容を見ながら、ご家庭の準備を相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please discuss your household preparations while referring to the guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二匹のうち一匹は知らない人を怖がります。そのことも伝えて、家族とどう運ぶか考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一匹が人を怖がることを伝え家族の運搬を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: One of the two cats is afraid of strangers. I will explain that too and consider with my family how to transport them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that one cat is afraid of people and consider how your family will transport them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その様子も担当へお伝えください。今日、避難先が決まるというご案内ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell the person in charge about that behavior too. This does not mean an evacuation destination will be decided today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。二匹いることと運ぶ物の不足を伝え、条件を確認して家族で準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当案内の条件を確認して家庭で備えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will say that I have two cats and not enough carriers, check the conditions, and prepare with my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the conditions in the staff guidance and prepare at home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、防災の担当へどうぞ。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go to the disaster preparedness staff. Thank you for consulting us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査のご案内ですが、何か確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is information about your examination. Is there anything you would like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 尿の検査があると聞きました。今は月経中なので、そのことを先にお伝えしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 尿検査前に月経中であると申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard there is a urine test. I am currently menstruating, so I wanted to tell you beforehand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you are menstruating before the urine test. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当へ確認します。もう採取されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check with the person in charge. Have you already collected the sample?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。受付で容器をもらいましたが、説明を聞く前に採ってしまわず、こちらへ来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 容器は受領したが未採取と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I received the container at reception, but came here instead of collecting a sample before hearing the instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have received the container but have not collected a sample. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その状況を伝えます。検査を進めるか、方法をどうするかは担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will explain the situation. The person in charge will check whether to proceed with the test and what method to use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日このまま検査を受けられるか、先に確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 当日の検査を進められるか担当の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. Could you check first whether I can have the test today as I am?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the person in charge to check whether today's test can proceed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 待っていただく間、未使用の容器はお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep the unused container with you while you wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 袋のまま持って待ちます。仕事の都合で、別の日に来るのが難しいことも伝えてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未使用容器を保持し仕事の来院制約も伝えてよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will hold it in its bag and wait. May I also tell them that coming another day is difficult because of work?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep the unused container and ask whether you may explain your work-related limits on clinic visits. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご事情も、担当へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell the person in charge about those circumstances too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は休みを取って来ました。月経中のことと来院の都合を説明し、検査の案内に従いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当日休暇取得と月経を担当へ説明し指示を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I took the day off to come today. I would like to explain that I am menstruating and my scheduling constraints, and follow the testing instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain to the person in charge that you took leave today and are menstruating, then await instructions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 月経中で未採取と担当へ伝えます。それでは、こちらでお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will tell the person in charge that you are menstruating and have not collected a sample. Please wait here. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご家族についてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to consult us about a family member?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父がいつもの時間に帰らず、携帯も家に置いたままです。どう相談すればよいか分からず来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 父の帰宅遅れと携帯自宅残置を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My father has not returned at his usual time, and his phone is still at home. I came because I did not know how to seek help.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Consult them about your father's late return and his phone being left at home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今分かっていることを伺います。最後にお父様と話したのは、いつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will ask what you know so far. When did you last speak to your father?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昼前です。買物に行くと言って出ました。帰る時刻を約束したわけではありませんが、普段よりかなり遅く心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最後の会話と買物予定を伝え帰宅時刻約束はないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Before noon. He went out saying he was going shopping. We did not agree on a return time, but he is much later than usual and I am worried.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State your last conversation and his shopping plans, explaining that no return time was agreed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お父様の様子や、出かけた時の服装は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you know how he was or what he was wearing when he left?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 青い上着でした。最近、道に迷ったことがあるので、そのことも担当へ伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 青上着と最近迷った経験を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: He was wearing a blue jacket. He has gotten lost recently, so I would like to tell the person in charge about that too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report the blue jacket and a recent instance of getting lost. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が詳しく伺います。連絡したご家族はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will ask for details. Have you contacted any family members?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 姉には聞きましたが、姉の所には来ていません。まだ確かめていない店もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 姉宅確認済みと未確認店舗を分け伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I asked my older sister, but he has not come to her place. There are also shops I have not checked yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish your checked sister's home from shops that remain unchecked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認した所と、未確認の所を分けてお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please separate the places you have checked from those you have not.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: メモに分けます。写真も携帯にあります。いつもの時間を過ぎたことと、最近迷ったことを合わせて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 写真と確認メモを示し二つの心配を担当へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will list them separately in a note. I also have a photo on my phone. I will consult them about both his being later than usual and his recent getting lost.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the photo and the checking notes, and tell the person in charge your two concerns. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当を呼びますのでこちらでお待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will call the person in charge, so please wait here. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 小さなお荷物をお送りになるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to send a small parcel, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 離れて住む家族へ家の鍵を返します。鍵が封筒を破らないよう、包み方を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鍵を返送するため封筒破損を防ぐ包み方を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am returning a house key to a family member who lives elsewhere. I would like to check how to wrap it so the key does not tear the envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Consult them about wrapping a key for return to prevent damage to the envelope. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中身を動きにくくする梱包について、担当へご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please ask the person in charge about packaging that keeps the contents from moving around.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 鍵は小さな袋に入れました。家族が何の鍵か分かるよう、家の住所のメモも入れた方がよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 鍵の袋と使用先を示す住所メモの同封を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have put the key in a small bag. Should I also enclose a note with the house address so my family knows which key it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Consult them about the bagged key and enclosing an address note identifying where it is used. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中に入れる説明はお客様でお決めください。鍵の確認だけでしたら、ご家族へ別に連絡することもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please decide yourself what explanation to enclose. If you only need to identify the key, you can contact your family separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族に電話して、どの鍵を返すか伝えます。袋には家族と決めた印を付けておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族への別連絡と識別印で鍵を知らせると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will call my family and say which key I am returning. I will put a mark on the bag that we agree on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to identify the key by separate contact with your family and an agreed mark. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 外側の宛名は、届く住所を正確にお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please write the correct delivery address on the outside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 宛先は家族の今の住まいです。鍵を使う家とは別なので、教えてもらった住所を外側に書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 鍵の使用先と別の家族の現住所を宛先にすると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The destination is my family's current home. That is different from the house where the key is used, so I will write the address they gave me outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that the destination is your family's current address, which differs from where the key is used. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 送り方と料金は、梱包した状態で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check the shipping method and price after it is packed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に家族へ受取りを頼み、教えてもらった包み方で用意します。届くまでの確認方法も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族へ受取り連絡し梱包と到着確認方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will first ask my family to receive it and prepare it using the wrapping method you explain. I would also like to ask how to check its progress until delivery.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Contact your family about receipt, and ask about packaging and how to confirm delivery. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 鍵の包み方について担当へおつなぎします。それでは、ご相談の席へどうぞ。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will connect you with the person in charge about wrapping the key. Please go to the consultation seat. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 貸金庫についてのお問い合わせでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you inquiring about a safe deposit box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 書類の保管を考えています。夜勤なので、出し入れできる時間が自分の生活に合うか、先に知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜勤に合う貸金庫の出入時間を先に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am considering storing documents. I work nights, so I would first like to know whether the access hours suit my lifestyle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: First ask about safe deposit box access hours that suit your night work. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 取扱いや利用時間は担当がご案内します。保管するのは、よくお使いになる物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The person in charge will explain the service and hours. Are the items you want to store things you use often?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 普段は使わない書類です。ただ、必要になった日にいつ取り出せるかを確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 保管物は普段使わないが必要な日の取出しが気になると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: They are documents I do not normally use. But I would like to check when I can take them out on a day I need them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the stored items are not used routinely but you are concerned about access on a day they are needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご来店しやすい曜日や時間はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Are there days or times when you can easily visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 休みは火曜で、午前なら来られます。仕事のある日は昼に寝ているので、毎日同じ時間に来るのは難しいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 火曜午前来店可と勤務日の昼は睡眠で来店困難を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: My day off is Tuesday, and I can come in the morning. On workdays I sleep during the day, so coming at the same time every day is difficult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you can visit on Tuesday mornings and that daytime sleep on workdays makes visiting difficult. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その予定を担当に伝えます。今日は契約のご相談までご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will tell the person in charge about that schedule. Would you like to discuss a contract today as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は説明を聞いて資料を持ち帰りたいです。家で保管する場合と比べて、家族にも相談してから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当日は説明資料のみ希望し家の保管と比較して家族と検討する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Today I would like to hear the explanation and take information home. I will compare it with storing the documents at home and discuss it with my family before deciding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request only an explanation and materials today, and compare with home storage and discuss with your family. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 利用時間のほかに確認したいことはございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is there anything you would like to check besides the hours?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 料金と、空きがない場合の相談方法も知りたいです。火曜午前に来られることと合わせて、担当にお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 料金と空きなしの場合の相談方法も担当へ尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I would also like to know the fees and how to consult you if there are no boxes available. Please tell the person in charge, along with my availability on Tuesday mornings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Also ask the person in charge about fees and consultation if none are available. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当へご案内します。資料についてもお尋ねください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take you to the person in charge. Please ask about information materials as well. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: かごの商品について、ご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the items in your basket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家の冷蔵庫が故障しました。一週間分を買うつもりでしたが、今日は買う物を変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷蔵庫故障により会計前の食品選択を変更したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My refrigerator at home has broken down. I intended to buy a week's worth, but I would like to change what I buy today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that because the refrigerator has broken down, you want to change your food choices before paying. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだお会計前ですね。不要になった物は、こちらへお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have not paid yet, correct? Please hand me the items you no longer need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この肉とヨーグルトをお願いします。家で置く所がないので、持ち帰ってから困る前に選び直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 保存できない肉とヨーグルトを店員へ渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please take this meat and yogurt. I have nowhere to store them at home, so I will choose again before taking them home and running into trouble.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Hand the meat and yogurt you cannot store to the shop assistant. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 保存条件は商品ごとに表示を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check each product's label for storage conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この缶詰は常温の案内を読めました。開けた後の条件も違うので、今日食べる分だけ買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未開封と開封後表示を見て当日分缶詰を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I could read the room-temperature storage instructions on this canned food. The conditions after opening are different too, so I will buy only what we will eat today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the unopened and opened storage labels and choose canned food just for today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 日用品も一緒にお買い求めになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will you also buy the daily necessities?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 洗剤と紙はそのまま買います。食品だけ見直すので、全部の買物を取り消すわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 日用品購入は維持し食品のみ見直すと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will still buy the detergent and paper. I am reconsidering only the food, not canceling all my shopping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will keep buying the daily necessities and reconsider only the food. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それでは、お渡しいただいた商品は店員が戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The shop assistant will return the items you handed over.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。会計するのは缶詰二つと日用品です。家族にも冷蔵品は今日は買っていないと知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確定購入内容と家族への連絡予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will pay for two cans and the daily necessities. I will also tell my family I have not bought refrigerated food today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State the confirmed purchases and your plan to inform your family. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容でお会計します。それでは、こちらへどうぞ。ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will charge you for those items. Please come this way. Thank you. Goodbye.
